page_title: PIS 0-1 UDI | Pisa v Udinese 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Davide Massa has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The referee points to the corner flag and Pisa will take a corner.
90+3' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) sees a yellow card from Davide Massa after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+2' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
86' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Matteo Tramoni is replaced by Calvin Stengs (Pisa).
86' It is time for a substitution. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is on for Michel Aebischer.
85' It will be a corner kick for Pisa.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa.
77' It looked like the long-range shot by Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
75' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) replacing Nicolo Bertola.
75' Substitution. Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
74' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Adrian Semper intercepts the ball.
73' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.
71' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
70' Razvan Sava displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
66' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Adrian Semper.
64' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
61' Substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) in, Iker Bravo out.
61' Here is a change. Keinan Davis is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Adam Buksa (Udinese).
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jakub Piotrowski walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
59' Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
53' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
52' The resulting set piece from Pisa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
49' Henrik Meister (Pisa) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Alberto Gilardino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mateus Lusuardi (Pisa). He is replaced by Giovanni Bonfanti.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris and Samuele Angori (Pisa) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) will not participate anymore and M'Bala Nzola is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Arthur Atta (Udinese) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
44' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
42' The ball is out of play and Pisa manage to earn a corner.
39' Arthur Atta (Udinese) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
39' Iker Bravo (Udinese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
39' Keinan Davis (Udinese) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
38' Razvan Sava blocks Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa)'s effort from the edge of the box.
34' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
28' The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.
27' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
23' The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
23' The ball is cleared after Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
18' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
17' Keinan Davis (Udinese) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
15' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is flagged for offside.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Iker Bravo (Udinese) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
14' Arthur Atta (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
12' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
9' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) makes a slide tackle, but referee Davide Massa blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Pisa.

8' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
5' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Udinese.
3' Henrik Meister (Pisa) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Pisa will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
